## Documentation checklist ([STANDARDS.md](../STANDARDS.md))
- [ ] Header (H1, Navigation line, Doc ID line) and Previous/Next footer present on new or changed pages.
- [ ] `DOCUMENT_REGISTER.md` row added/updated; **Revised** dates updated; `CHANGELOG.md` bullet added.
- [ ] Routes, `WP-` numbers, role names and counts verified; nothing invented.
- [ ] Synthetic data only; no secrets, personal data, internal hostnames, personal mailboxes or unverified hotline numbers.
- [ ] One H1; no skipped headings; tables well-formed; glossary terms linked.
- [ ] Images have descriptive alt text and a dated synthetic caption; SVGs have `<title>` and `<desc>`.
- [ ] Links checked; FAQ and wiki updated if user-facing behaviour changed.
- [ ] Legal statements say "confirm with a lawyer or the DPO"; translations marked "needs native-speaker review".

Only the Product Owner approves and merges.
